---
title: "Publications"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, results = "asis", message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
library(glue)
```

Journal articles and working papers, refreshed weekly from
[ORCID](https://orcid.org/0000-0002-3039-2004) and [OpenAlex](https://openalex.org).
Official World Bank reports and working papers are pulled separately from Brian's
[World Bank staff profile](https://www.worldbank.org/en/about/people/b/brian-william-stacy).

## Journal articles & working papers

```{r}
pubs <- read_csv("data/publications_auto.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  arrange(desc(year))

pubs %>%
  mutate(
    authored_with = ifelse(is.na(coauthors) | coauthors == "", "", glue("Authored with {coauthors}.")),
    cited = glue("Cited by {cited_by_count} (OpenAlex)"),
    link_md = ifelse(is.na(link), "", glue("[View]({link})"))
  ) %>%
  glue_data(
    "<div class='entry'>\n\n",
    "**{title}** ({year})\n\n",
    "<span class='venue'>{venue}</span>\n\n",
    "<span class='meta'>{authored_with} {cited}. {link_md}</span>\n\n",
    "</div>\n"
  ) %>%
  paste(collapse = "\n") %>%
  cat()
```

## World Bank reports

```{r}
reports <- read_csv("data/wb_reports_auto.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  arrange(desc(date))

reports %>%
  mutate(
    year = format(date, "%Y"),
    link_md = ifelse(is.na(url), "", glue("[View]({url})"))
  ) %>%
  glue_data(
    "<div class='entry'>\n\n",
    "**{title}** ({year})\n\n",
    "<span class='meta'>{type}. {link_md}</span>\n\n",
    "</div>\n"
  ) %>%
  paste(collapse = "\n") %>%
  cat()
```
